usescript.description: Use flags embedded in scripts to set queuing options - not supported
usescript.title: Use Script

jobhold.description: Place a hold on this task until specified job id has completed.
jobhold.title: Job Hold

not_requeueable.description: Job cannot be requeued in the event of a node failure.
not_requeueable.title: Not Requeueable

array_hold.description: Not supported - will be converted to simple job hold
array_hold.title: Array Hold

novalidation.description: Don't check for presence of script/binary in your searchpath
novalidation.title: No Validation

name.description: Specify job name as it will appear on queue.
name.title: Job Name

queue.description: Specify the queue for the job (irrelevant if not running in a cluster environment).
queue.title: Queue

resource.description: Pass a resource request or constraint string through to the job scheduler.
resource.title: Resource

jobram.description: Max total RAM required for job (integer in GB).
jobram.title: Job RAM

array_task.description: Specify a task file of commands to execute in parallel.
array_task.title: Array Task

array_native.description: Binary/Script will handle array task internally (mutually exclusive with --array_task).
array_native.title: Array Native

array_limit.description: Specify the maximum number of parallel job sub-tasks to run concurrently.
array_limit.title: Array Limit

keep_jobscript.description: Whether to create and save a job submission script.
keep_jobscript.title: Keep Jobscript

project.description: Specify the project (not relevant when not running in a cluster environment).
project.title: Project

noramsplit.description: Disable RAM splitting (not relevant when not running in a cluster environment).
noramsplit.title: No RAM Split

jobtime.description: Estimated job length in minutes, used to automatically choose the queue name.
jobtime.title: Job Time

has_coprocessor.description: fsl_sub returns with exit code of 0 if specified coprocessor is configured.
has_coprocessor.title: Has Coprocessor

has_queues.description: fsl_sub returns with exit code of 0 if there's a compute cluster with queues configured.
has_queues.title: Has Queues

show_config.description: Display the configuration currently in force.
show_config.title: Show Config

version.description: Show program's version number and exit.
version.title: Version

fileisimage.description: If <file> already exists and is an MRI image file, do nothing and exit.
fileisimage.title: File is Image
